info.name: Google Vids API v1 by useapi.net
info.description:
## [Google Vids API v1](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1)

Google Vids API by useapi.net: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video (text, start image, up to 3 image and avatar references, 3-10 s, 720p or 1080p), extend, upscale to 1080p, edit, images in 7 styles, uploads, downloads, jobs, voiced avatars and the voice list. Runs on your own Google AI plan accounts, no captcha. Set the `api-token` collection variable (see https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi). POST accounts sends form-data, the other POST bodies send JSON (the API accepts JSON or form-data for every body). POST assets sends the file itself as the body. Ids contain `:` and `@`: URL-encode them when you put them in a path variable.

---
**Updated:** October 7, 2026

formdata.description: Required to add/re-add. The cookie table of https://docs.google.com copied from DevTools (Application → Cookies), pasted as copied (min 20 chars). Must contain SID, HSID, SSID, APISID, SAPISID, __Secure-1PSIDTS and OSID. The account email is read from Google. Free Google accounts (0 video, 0 images) are refused. See Setup Google Vids: https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-google-vids
Update mode only: a connected account email, sent with maxJobs and without cookies. Not accepted together with cookies.
Optional when adding (default 3). Required in update mode. Max concurrent jobs for this account, 1-10.

request.description:
## [Generate a video](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-videos)

**Body (JSON).** `prompt` is required (up to 5000 chars, may use `@referenceImage_1..3` / `@avatar_1..3` markers).

- `duration`: 3-10 seconds, default 8
- `aspectRatio`: `landscape` (default) or `portrait`
- `resolution`: `720p` (default) or `1080p`, same cost
- `startImage`: assetId from POST /assets, or an image mediaId from POST images (uploaded for you). Not with references.
- `referenceImage_1`..`referenceImage_3`: assetIds from POST /assets or image mediaIds from POST images
- `avatar_1`..`avatar_3`: avatarIds from POST /avatars or GET /avatars. At most 3 references and avatars together.
- `email`: account to run on. Default: the account holding the inputs, or a load-balanced one.
- `async`: `true` answers 202 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

body.raw:
{
    "prompt": "A paper boat drifting down a rain gutter, close up",
    "duration": 8,
    "aspectRatio": "landscape",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "async": false
}

request.description:
## [Extend a video](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-videos-extend)

**Body (JSON).** `mediaId` (a video mediaId from a finished job) and `prompt` are required.

- `duration`: seconds to add, 3-10, default 8. Charged only these seconds. The whole clip is returned, up to about 41 s.
- `aspectRatio`: `landscape` or `portrait`. Default: the source's.
- `resolution`: `720p` or `1080p`. Default: the source's.
- `async`: `true` answers 202 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

## [Upscale a video to 1080p](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-videos-upscale)

**Body (JSON).** `mediaId` of a 720p clip of up to 20 seconds is required. A 1080p clip or one longer than 20 seconds is refused with 400. Charged the clip's seconds again.

- `async`: `true` answers 202 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

## [Edit a video](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-videos-edit)

**Body (JSON).** `video` (a video mediaId from a finished job) and `prompt` are required. An uploaded video (assetId) is accepted, but Google refuses it with 422.

- `duration`: 3-10. Default: the clip's length, up to 10 (an edit works on 10 seconds). Required with an assetId.
- `aspectRatio`, `resolution`: default the source's.
- `async`: `true` answers 202 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

## [Generate an image](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-images)

**Body (JSON).** `prompt` is required (up to 5000 chars). One JPEG of a fixed size.

- `aspectRatio`: `16:9` (default, 1376×768), `1:1` (1024×1024), `9:16` (768×1376)
- `style`: `none` (default), `photography`, `sketch`, `background`, `watercolor`, `vector-art`, `cyberpunk`
- `email`: account to run on. Default: a load-balanced one.
- `async`: `true` answers 202 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

header.description: The file's MIME type: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp or video/mp4.

query.description: Optional. The account to upload to. Default: a random healthy account.

request.description:
## [Upload an asset](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-assets)

The file is the raw request body (no multipart, no JSON), 1 byte to 50 MB. Returns the assetId used as startImage / referenceImage_N of POST videos (an image made with POST images needs no upload: pass its mediaId there).

## [Download a video or image](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/get-google-vids-media-mediaId)

Streams the MP4 or JPEG from Google. A Range header is passed through (206).

## [Create an avatar](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1/post-google-vids-avatars)

**Body (JSON).** `name` (1-40 chars) and `voice` (a name or voice id from GET voices) are required, plus either `image` or `appearance`.

- `image`: an image mediaId from POST images (an uploaded photo is refused: Google's likeness check)
- `appearance`: the person to draw, up to 500 chars (uses 1 image of the monthly allowance)
- `outfit` (300), `shot` (`close-up` default, `upper-body`, `full-body`), `expression` (200), `details` (1000): with appearance only
- `email`: account to save it on

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Marco",
    "voice": "Holt",
    "appearance": "a middle-aged man with a short grey beard",
    "outfit": "navy blazer over a white shirt",
    "shot": "upper-body"
}
